description: so thankful for everyone in our baking community!! cannot believe there are over 25k of us here! 🥺🎉🫶🏽 recipe: @moribyan  #baketok #bestcookies #baketok #baking
transcript: Sometimes you just don't feel like waiting two business days to eat a chocolate chip cookie. And so if you want to make homemade chocolate chip cookies from scratch and you want them to be really delicious, this is probably a recipe you need to give a try. The Caribbean brown butter chocolate chip cookies and they are amazing. People say that brown butter cookies are overrated, but I baked a lot of cookies in this series. And the consensus is try them. If you don't like them, you don't ever have to make them again. And I promise you no one's going to be mad if you give them some chocolate chip cookies made from brown butter. And because no one wants to waste their time or their ingredients, you can just go ahead and follow my page and find your favorite chocolate chip cookie, which is the whole entire point of. Anyway, if you stuck around this long, then I assume that you're either going to try this recipe or you just like the sound of my voice. And with that, I still have a lot more cookies to try, but I really want to lean into doing brownies as my next series. So you'll see some brownie recipes sprouting, be sure to stick around. So thankful that there's over 25,000 of you guys hearing all the pictures of everybody's cookies and baked good. This is such a fun journey that I've been on. And I'm so excited to see where it takes us. If you decide to try this recipe, don't forget to drop a picture in the comments below. Love you. Bye.
